contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001-THM-0007, OBS-0001 or RED-0001. Exact content, verified independently. Excision plus the long exact sequence of the pair (Mbar_{g,n}, ∂Mbar_{g,n}) gives ker(H^{2r}(Mbar_{g,n};Q) -> H^{2r}(∂Mbar_{g,n};Q)) = im(H^{2r}_c(M_{g,n}) -> H^{2r}(Mbar_{g,n})); since H^{2r}(Mbar_{g,n}) is pure of weight 2r (THM-0001) and the map is a strict morphism of MHS, that image is gr^W_{2r}H^{2r}_c(M_{g,n}), which under H^{BM}_k = (H^k_c)^dual is exactly the Q-dual of the RED-0001 open input W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}) appearing as the cokernel in THM-0003 / SRC-0002 (6.1) — the live-retrieved Payne 2026 survey states the same localization sequence 'H^{k-2}(D~_{g,n})(-1) -> H^k(Mbar_{g,n}) -> W_k H^k(M_{g,n}) -> 0'. The diagonal 2r = 2g+n-2 is not incidental: Harer's vcd (4g-4+n for g>=2, n>0; 4g-5 for n=0) with Poincare duality on the d = 3g-3+n dimensional M_{g,n} gives H^k_c(M_{g,n}) = 0 for k < 2g-2+n when n >= 1, so 2r = 2g+n-2 is precisely the first degree in which this kernel can be nonzero; the survey records the same threshold ('the compactly supported cohomology of M_{g,n} vanishes in degrees less than roughly 2g+n-1', from 'roughly 4g-4+n, for g>=2') and states that 'the prediction that H^k(Mbar_{g,n}) is pure Tate for even k <= 20 is confirmed for k <= 14, but the cases 16, 18, and 20 remain open'. With 2g+n = 18 the diagonal is 2r = 16, so the audited premise 'at the diagonal only the kernel is Tate' is exactly the C66-001 theorem for (6,6) and nothing more. The conclusion is correct and sharp: by corroborated FND-0033 (semisimplicity of polarizable pure weight-2r Q-Hodge structures) the sequence 0 -> ker -> H^{2r}(Mbar_{g,n}) -> im(res) -> 0 splits, hence H^{2r}(Mbar_{g,n}) is Tate iff BOTH the kernel and im(res) subset H^{2r}(∂) are Tate; kernel-Tate leaves the image wholly unconstrained, and no extension subtlety disguises the gap (elementary witness: X = S x P^1 with S a K3 and D = S x {0} has ker(H^2(X) -> H^2(D)) = Q(-1), Tate, while H^2(X) contains the non-Tate H^2(S)). Non-vacuity at (6,6): by corroborated FND-0034 the codimension-one boundary pieces are Mbar_{5,8}/S_2 and separating products Mbar_{i,a+1} x Mbar_{6-i,b+1}, and (5,8) is itself an unresolved RED-0001 pair, so the residual quotient is discharged by no established input; the deeper stratified/descent contributions to H^{16}(∂) are likewise untouched by the campaign theorem. Mild scope sharpenings, not affecting the verdict: (i) the kernel identification requires D to be the full boundary — for a proper sub-divisor the kernel is larger and insufficiency holds a fortiori; (ii) '2g+n-2' is the n >= 1 form of the threshold (n = 0 gives 2g-1; consistent with FND-0035, where degree 16 sits one above threshold for (8,0),(8,1)); (iii) the finding must not be read as alleging a defect in the THM-0003/THM-0004 induction, which does control the boundary but only by simultaneously discharging the open inputs of all smaller pairs — for (6,6) that means (5,8) — so the correct reading is a scope limit on what a single-pair open-input theorem buys, exactly matching the survey's 'for fixed k only finitely many small pairs (g,n) can contribute'. Distinctness (do not merge, merge_target_id null): FND-0031 concerns what the weight spectral sequence yields FOR the open input (the opposite direction of the same sequence), FND-0034 concerns identification of the non-separating divisor, FND-0048 concerns identification of the open pure piece with a decorated stable-graph complex, FND-0057 concerns campaign-graph dependency consistency, and retired FND-0012 was execution-scope policy with no exact-sequence content. Live recency check found no 2026 result closing the gap: arXiv:2603.26962 (Bergstrom-Wennink, 27 March 2026) computes weight-graded pieces only where the boundary stratification cohomology is already tautological, and the known unconditional Tate range 3g+2n < 25 excludes (6,6) (30). Verdict: promote from candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source. Independence: no Grok worker was dispatched — grok is the excluded engine here (finding reviewer_engines ['grok'], REV-0035) and using it would compromise independence; all verification is claude-side against live primary sources. Retrieval caveats reported in good faith: content_sha256 is null on every record because this read-only workspace exposes no hashing facility (no shell), and fabricating digests was refused; retrieved_at is date-precision UTC for the same reason; the arXiv:2307.08830 PDF and ar5iv renderings did not expose Section 6 to the fetcher, so equation (6.1) was corroborated through the identical localization sequence quoted from arXiv:2605.20453 together with the SRC-0002 locators already cross-checked in the campaign corpus, and the Harer 1986 Springer page (DOI 10.1007/BF01388737) redirected to an authentication gate, so the vcd values were taken from the survey rather than from the original article.
